text: 1. Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2. Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3. Master's degree diploma Graduation certificate should be in Chinese or English. If not, it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized. 4. Transcript of postgraduate school 5.Two recommendation letters From professor,associate professor or equivalents. 6.GMAT/GRE score Authorized Copy of GMAT score of 680 or above and GRE score of 2000 or above within the period of validity of 5 years. 7.Copy of article or papers published Table of contents and abstracts of your academic publications and any other original achievement in your field of study 8.Statement of purpose 800 words for master program and 1500 words for doctorate program, must be in Chinese You can download a template or sample from here. 9.TOEFL score For example, IELTS or TOEFL, only for applicant whose native language is not English.
